通过架构革新与增加易用性提高了用户粘性；精简链路帮助决策，显著减少了用户跳出，提: A clearer structure improved engagement. Shorter workflows and decision support reduced drop-off and increased rendering volume. Cross-device support and intelligent features contributed to higher conversion.
通过整体改版，根据客服回访与产品现场沟通的方式了解到，用户满意度提升了60%，活: Following the redesign, customer-service follow-ups and on-site conversations indicated a 60% rise in satisfaction. Active users increased by 23%.
统一色彩、字体、间距、圆角等视觉变量，建立清晰的界面基础规则: Set common visual rules for color, type, spacing and corner radii
梳理高频页面与核心业务场景，提取可复用的基础组件和业务组件: Identify reusable foundational and product components from frequently used screens and core tasks
补充组件的不同状态，提升复杂场景下的可用性: Define component states for more complex scenarios
推动设计组件与代码组件命名、属性和版本保持一致: Keep names, properties and versions aligned across design and code
通过实际项目验证，并持续回收问题与迭代: Validate the system in real projects and revise it as issues emerge
梳理核心业务链路，保证用户在不同设备间切换时理解成本更低: Map core workflows so users can move between devices with less effort
根据屏幕尺寸调整信息密度，电脑端承载更多信息，移动端突出关键内容: Adjust density by screen size, with more detail on desktop and key content prioritized on mobile
组件建立跨端适配规则确保稳定性，根据操作方式差异调整交互细节: Set adaptation rules for shared components and adjust interactions to suit different inputs
设计交付时补充不同端的布局说明，帮助研发理解响应式和适配规则: Include device-specific layout notes so engineering can implement responsive behavior
根据业务反馈持续调整各端优先级，让多端体验更贴近真实使用场景: Refine device priorities using feedback from real use
参与需求评审，与产品拆解需求，明确目标、范围与优先级: Review and break down requirements with the product team to agree on goals, scope and priorities
通过交互原型说明设计逻辑，降低团队理解偏差: Use interactive prototypes to explain the design and build a shared understanding
与研发提前对齐技术可行性，并通过设计走查保障还原质量: Check feasibility with engineering early and review the implementation against the design
整理评审反馈、边界状态和验收问题，推动关键问题逐项解决: Track feedback, edge cases and acceptance issues through resolution
